description: UX A3: mob script API on 2 windowed F2F 0.32 clients (A = alice, B = bob) + real olife-sandboxd (--state-dir, persist every 20 ticks). alice's bench runs sandbox/a3_api_test.lua: queries answered next tick (block.get/get_area/raycast/is_replaceable/find, nearby, skeleton:bones, memory), block.set with state + fill_area 3x1x3 read back, appearance (scale, rot {yaw}, texture *, bone transform, bone model, text3d, wave animation), refusals of the world (bounds, bad texture/sound/bone/text, value too large) back as rejected events; world state (`mob_api`) and the engine view on B and A (transform size/rot, skeleton textures/matrices/models, animation time advancing, text3d, visibility toggles, sounds); permission stub (olife.api_deny sound -> forbidden, no sounds on B; allow -> sounds again); price of every call from the world's per-tick rows (a3_cost_probe); the five demo_* samples via spawn_sample; consistency; then a world restart (memory and the Lua variable continue: LoadKeep, appearance back on B, animation not persisted) and a hard kill of the sandbox (variable continues from the owner image on disk, memory from the world store).
